proposed_decisions.question: When the detector does not apply a sign to a channel, how should conversion publish that channel?
proposed_decisions.options_ordered_by: number of channels published under the LocoHub sign rule, fewest first

options.label: Publish only channels the detector applied; hold the rest back
options.consequence: In the GT21 pilot 343 of 648 leg-channels were not applied (including every knee moment and knee power) and would be left out until new evidence; no per-dataset sign code; reversible.

options.label: Use the audited dataset sign only where the detector suggests the same sign
options.consequence: Adds suggested channels that agree with the audit; channels where the detector abstains or conflicts (e.g. knee power) are left out; reversible.

options.label: Use the audited dataset sign for every audited channel; the detector is a stop-check
options.consequence: Every audited channel is published; per-dataset sign code stays for unapplied channels; any applied sign that contradicts the audit stops the run; reversible.

proposed_decisions.cost_of_waiting: Full reconversion runs stay blocked; pilots can still run because they publish nothing.
proposed_decisions.why: The data contract already accepts audited source mappings (model files, publisher documentation) as independent evidence, and all four pilots found no wrong sign; the detector then guards against mixed storage (UM21 power layouts, AB04/i0 pelvis) without dropping half the channels.
proposed_decisions.check: Open the GT21 pilot sheet: in figure 1, the knee moment and power rows are almost never dark green (applied).

publication_policy.decision: D-CORE-11-1 withdrawn; not a José decision.
publication_policy.basis: José's standing preference as relayed by the coordinator for CORE-11 on 2026-10-31: standardized names by default whenever a verified audit supports the sign; 'leave out' is not a neutral option. Consistent with his answer C to D-UM21-C01-1. I found no separate written record of the preference in the repository; the coordinator's message is the source.
publication_policy.rule: verified audit + detector applied/suggested same or abstained -> publish with audited sign; verified audit + detector suggests/applies opposite or conflict -> hold, not published; no verified audit -> detector alone (guarded apply publishes, otherwise hold). Audit verified only when its task is done in backlog.
